name: context-capsule
description: Turn what you worked on into a capsule: a short summary per project, with your decisions and why.
long_description: Context Capsule records the text of the screen you choose (and your voice notes) on your own computer. Claude uses this extension to start and stop recordings, read a short timeline of your day, sort it into projects, and write capsules you can keep or share. Nothing is uploaded by the extension; it only reads and writes files in your Context Capsule folder. Needs the Context Capsule app.
